// diagnostic

E3304

`{module}` is not available for target `{target}`.

What

`{module}` is not available for target `{target}`.

Why

`{module}` needs native sockets or WASI Preview 2 sockets, and this target provides neither runtime boundary.

Fix

Build for `wasm32-wasip2` or a supported native target, or remove the `{module}` import.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3304: tests/ui/wasip2_unsupported_socket_surface_e3304.stderr.

Error [E3304]: `core.net` is not available for target `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.
  --> tests/ui/wasip2_unsupported_socket_surface_e3304.jet:2:5
    |
  2 | use core.net as net
    |     ^^^^^^^^
 Why: `core.net` needs native sockets or WASI Preview 2 sockets, and this target provides neither runtime boundary.
 Fix: build for `wasm32-wasip2` or a supported native target, or remove the `core.net` import.
